name: @forgeax/native-ray-query-triangle-tauri
description: Packaged Tauri proof that ForgeaX can present native Metal, DX12 or Vulkan Ray Query output in a desktop viewport.

scripts.verify:native-contract: pnpm verify:native-owner && pnpm test:report && pnpm test:conformance-report && pnpm test:native && pnpm check:native

bundle-size.reason: The spike proves native routing and packaged execution; no stable bundle-size baseline exists.

fps.reason: The fixed triangle is a bounded correctness proof, not a frame-rate workload.

bench.reason: Equivalent raster and compute workloads are outside the native-route spike.

spike-report.reason: Hardware reports are runtime CI artifacts; the reviewed implementation report lives in the Engine Harness docs repository.
